title: Peter Pan
desc:
Fly away to Neverland this festive season!

Adapted by Phil Porter with original music by Ruth Chan and directed by Joe Murphy, this faithful, enchanting re-telling of J M Barrie’s classic tale is a magical family show bursting with imagination, flying, and original songs.

Access performances

  • Relaxed (Sun 10 Jan 11am)
  • Audio Described (Sat 12 Dec & Sat 9 Jan at 2pm with pre-show Touch Tour at 12:30pm)
  • BSL Interpreted (Thu 3 Dec at 10:15am & 2:30pm, Fri 4 Dec at 6:30pm)
  • Captioned dates across select November, December, and January performances.

title: Mrs. Doubtfire the Musical
desc:
Say "Helloooo, Birmingham!" The critically acclaimed West End and Broadway musical comedy Mrs. Doubtfire launches its very first UK and Ireland tour right here at Birmingham Hippodrome! Starring Gabriel Vick reprising his acclaimed West End role, this hilarious and heartwarming family show is packed with iconic moments, brilliant original songs, and spectacular quick-changes as Daniel Hillard goes to extraordinary lengths to stay in his children's lives.

Key Accessible Performances:

  • Captioned: Thu 27 Aug & Thu 10 Sep (7.30pm) – by Stevie Burrows
  • BSL Interpreted: Wed 26 Aug & Wed 9 Sep (7.30pm)
  • Audio Described: Sat 29 Aug & Sat 12 Sep (2.30pm) – by Jonathan Nash
  • Touch Tour: Sat 29 Aug & Sat 12 Sep (1.15pm)

Find full accessibility information here or contact the Hippodrome access team on 0121 689 1060.

title: Treasure Island
desc:
Ahoy, Wolverhampton! A brand-new swashbuckling panto adventure for the 2026/27 festive season.

Fresh from clinching Best Panto in the UK at the UK Pantomime Awards, Wolverhampton Grand is premiering a never-before-seen pantomime adventure starring firm audience favourites Tam Ryan and Ian Adams. Expect high-seas slapstick, dazzling sets, and accessible festive fun for all ages.

Wolverhampton Grand provides dedicated relaxed and sensory-adapted performances featuring softened stage effects, lowered sound volume, and access to quiet breakout areas.

Key Accessible Performances & Highlights:

  • Relaxed Performances – Thursday 10 December at 11am | Friday 11 December at 11am | Saturday 12 December at 11am
  • Audio Described Performances – Sunday 6 December at 3pm | Tuesday 8 December at 10.30am | Saturday 2 January at 2pm
  • BSL Interpreted Performances – Thursday 10 December at 11am & 7pm | Friday 11 December at 11am | Saturday 12 December at 11am | Sunday 3 January at 11am
  • Captioned Performance – Sunday 6 December at 3pm

title: Sleeping Beauty
desc:
A firm family favourite returns to the Hippodrome stage: Birmingham pantomime legends Matt Slack and Andrew Ryan return to bring spectacular festive laughs, magic, and show-stopping musical numbers to this brand-new production of Sleeping Beauty.

Key Accessible Performances & Highlights:

  • BSL Interpreted: Sun 10 Jan (1pm & 5.15pm) – Interpreted by Rachel Tipping & Clare Edwards
  • Captioned: Sun 17 Jan (1pm & 5.15pm)
  • Audio Described: Wed 13 Jan (2pm) & Sat 16 Jan (2.30pm)
  • Relaxed Performance: Thu 28 Jan (12:00 noon)

title: Robin Hood
desc:
Arrow-right into pure panto perfection!

Join our merry crew for double the laughter, double the fun, and double the Ben as the Lichfield Garrick presents its first in-house pantomime in over a decade.

Accessible Performances:

  • Relaxed Performance on Sunday 29th November at 11am
  • BSL Signed Performances on Thursday 17th December at 7pm and Sunday 3rd January at 11am.

Read more about the upcoming show and full story on Lichfields Garricks first in-house panto in over a decade here

title: Aladdin Pantomime
desc:
Make Christmas Wishes Come True, with magical Mark, David, Sam and YOU!

Climb aboard the magic carpet and soar into the spectacular world of Aladdin – The unmissable family pantomime for 2026 starring Mark Rhodes, David Phipps-Davis and Samantha Spragg!

Will Aladdin outwit the wicked sorcerer, claim his fortune, and win the heart of his true love, Jasmine? Join us to find out in a spellbinding adventure bursting with laughter, wonder, and festive cheer.

Packed with side-splitting comedy, dazzling costumes, and show-stopping musical numbers, Aladdin has all the ingredients for the ultimate Christmas treat.

Accessible Performances

  • Relaxed Performance: December 19, 11am
  • BSL Interpreted Performance: December 27, 1pm

title: Beauty and the Beast
desc:
For Christmas 2026, the Belgrade presents the most enchanting tale of all, Beauty and the Beast!

One of the most popular panto titles ever, this production is guaranteed to bring a touch of magic, mayhem and monstrous fun to your festive celebrations.

Written by and starring Coventry’s favourite dame, Iain Lauchlan, Beauty and the Beast features breathtaking sets, crazy costumes, and seasonal silliness.

Accessible & Special Performances:

  • Touch Tour available on Sat 5 Dec (11:30am)
  • Audio Described (AD) & BSL on Sat 5 Dec (2pm)
  • Captioned (CAP) on Thu 17 Dec (6:30pm)
  • Captioned & Relaxed Performance (CAP/RP) on Wed 30 Dec (2pm)
  • Lap seat tickets and free booster seats available via the box office (Booster seats limited).

title: Dog Man: The Musical
desc: With the head of a dog and the body of a policeman, Dog Man loves to fight crime and chew on furniture!.. Paw-sitively brilliant stage adaptation based on Dav Pilkey's worldwide bestselling Dog Man book series.

title: Elf The Musical
desc: “You’d have to be a cotton-headed ninny muggins” to miss Buddy the elf this festive season.

title: Paddington The Musical
desc: A small bear in a big city! Family-friendly stage show at London's Savoy Theatre that tells the story of a little lost bear who finds a new home with the Brown family.

title: Birmingham Royal Ballet - Swan Lake
desc:
A spellbinding celebration of classical ballet and music

Birmingham Royal Ballet revives Sir Peter Wright and Galina Samsova’s glorious journey into Swan Lake – with the Royal Ballet Sinfonia performing Tchaikovsky’s superb music live alongside BRB’s spectacular dancers.

Prince Siegfried is out hunting one night when he happens upon a flock of graceful swans. When one of them turns into a beautiful woman, the Prince is utterly smitten – but Odette explains that she has fallen under an evil spell cast by Baron von Rothbart, which keeps her in swan form from dawn to dusk. Can Siegfried’s love break the spell?

Find out in this exquisite production of a true ballet classic.

Access Performances & Touch Tours

  • Touch Tour: Sat 26 Sep, 11.15am (Familiarise with set, props, and costumes)

  • Audio Described: Sat 26 Sep, 2pm

Note: BSL, Captioned, and Relaxed performances vary by date. Please check the access registration portal.
